author: Nerd of the Rings
description:
Today, we march through all the realms of Men in Middle-earth, from Numenor and Rhun to Gondor and Rohan.  From the mighty kingdoms like Harad to the smaller lands of Khand, Bree, and Dale.  This is an epic journey through the Kingdoms of Men!

Hit subscribe and the bell for great Tolkien content every week!
